fields.title: Instagram public content record
fields.description: One row per scraped entity. The five modes share this envelope, so every field is nullable and only the fields relevant to a row's `_mode` are populated. Read `_mode` first, then `_source` (which tells you whether the row came from the server-rendered page or from a paginated GraphQL replay) and `_warning` (which records surface limits such as the profile grid not publishing engagement counts). Rows that failed carry `_error` instead of data - every input produces at least one row.

_mode.title: Mode
_mode.description: Which surface produced this row: profile, posts, reels, post_detail or location.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The username, shortcode or location id this row belongs to, as resolved from your input entry.

_source.title: Source
_source.description: ssr-relay-island when the row came from the server-rendered page (page 1 of any surface), api-graphql-replay when it came from a paginated /api/graphql/ request, or none on a failure row.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of the scrape.

_page.title: Page
_page.description: Which page of the connection this item came from. 1 means it was server-rendered into the entity page.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal limitation affecting this row. Common values: engagement_not_published_on_this_surface (the profile grid omits like/comment counts - use post_detail or reels), comments_truncated (Instagram serves only the first ~13 comments to logged-out viewers), single_page_surface (the location tab ignores pagination cursors), private_account, pagination_stopped_at_page_N.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows: INVALID_INPUT, NOT_FOUND, PRIVATE_ACCOUNT, BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED, EMPTY_RESULT or GATED_FOR_LOGGED_OUT.

id.title: ID
id.description: Instagram numeric id of the account (profile mode) or of the media (media modes).

url.title: URL
url.description: Canonical instagram.com URL of the profile or the post.

isVerified.title: Verified
isVerified.description: Whether the account carries a verified badge.

isPrivate.title: Private
isPrivate.description: Whether the account is private. Private accounts expose profile metadata but no media to logged-out viewers.

isUnpublished.title: Unpublished
isUnpublished.description: Whether Instagram has unpublished the account.

followerCount.title: Followers
followerCount.description: Exact follower count - not the rounded value shown in Instagram's meta tags.

followingCount.title: Following
followingCount.description: Exact number of accounts this account follows.

mediaCount.title: Media count
mediaCount.description: Total media the account has published.

hasClips.title: Has reels
hasClips.description: Whether the account has a reels tab worth scraping with mode 'reels'.

profilePicUrl.title: Profile picture URL
profilePicUrl.description: Profile picture. Instagram CDN URLs are signed and expire - download promptly if the image matters.

accountBadges.title: Account badges
accountBadges.description: Badges Instagram attaches to the account.

bioLinks.title: Bio links
bioLinks.description: Links in the profile bio, each with url, title and linkType.

hasThreadsBadge.title: Has Threads badge
hasThreadsBadge.description: Whether the profile shows a Threads badge.

threadsBadgeLabel.title: Threads handle
threadsBadgeLabel.description: The Threads handle shown on the badge.

linkedFacebookPage.title: Linked Facebook page
linkedFacebookPage.description: Facebook page linked to the account, when published.

highlights.title: Story highlights
highlights.description: Highlight reels on the profile, each with id, title and coverUrl. Titles and covers only - highlight contents require a login.

shortcode.title: Shortcode
shortcode.description: The post's short code, the segment in /p/<code>/.

typename.title: GraphQL typename
typename.description: Instagram's own type for the media, e.g. XIGPolarisImageMedia.

productType.title: Product type
productType.description: Instagram's media kind: feed, clips (reel) or igtv. This is a media format, not a shopping product.

takenAt.title: Taken at
takenAt.description: When the media was published, UTC ISO 8601. Not published on the profile grid surface - null for posts-mode rows.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtags parsed out of the caption, without the leading #.

mentions.title: Mentions
mentions.description: @mentions parsed out of the caption, without the leading @.

accessibilityCaption.title: Accessibility caption
accessibilityCaption.description: Instagram's auto-generated description of the image.

likeCount.title: Likes
likeCount.description: Like count. Null - never 0 - when the serving surface does not publish it, which is the case for every posts-mode row.

commentCount.title: Comments
commentCount.description: Total comments on the media, as Instagram reports it. This is the true total even when only the first few comments were scraped.

playCount.title: Plays
playCount.description: Video plays. Populated on reels-mode rows.

viewCount.title: Views
viewCount.description: View count, where Instagram publishes it.

countsDisabled.title: Counts hidden
countsDisabled.description: True when the author hid like and view counts - distinguishes a deliberately hidden count from a surface that simply does not publish one.

commentsDisabled.title: Comments disabled
commentsDisabled.description: Whether commenting is turned off for this media.

isPaidPartnership.title: Paid partnership
isPaidPartnership.description: Whether the post is flagged as a paid partnership.

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: Highest-resolution still available on the serving surface. Instagram CDN URLs are signed and expire.

videoUrl.title: Video URL
videoUrl.description: Highest-resolution video file, where the surface publishes one (location mode does; the profile grid does not).

hasAudio.title: Has audio
hasAudio.description: Whether the video carries an audio track.

carouselCount.title: Carousel items
carouselCount.description: Number of items in a carousel post.

ownerUsername.title: Owner username
ownerUsername.description: Handle of the account that published the media.

ownerId.title: Owner ID
ownerId.description: Numeric id of the publishing account.

ownerFullName.title: Owner full name
ownerFullName.description: Display name of the publishing account.

ownerIsVerified.title: Owner verified
ownerIsVerified.description: Whether the publishing account is verified.

comments.title: Comments
comments.description: Comments attached to a post_detail row, each with text, createdAt, likeCount, replyCount and author fields. Limited to what Instagram serves logged-out viewers - about the first 13 - because its comment pagination endpoint requires a login. Check _warning and compare against commentCount.

commentsScraped.title: Comments scraped
commentsScraped.description: How many comments this row actually carries, as opposed to commentCount, which is the post's true total.

locationId.title: Location ID
locationId.description: Instagram numeric id of the place.

locationCategory.title: Location category
locationCategory.description: Instagram's category for the place, e.g. City or Restaurant.

locationMediaCount.title: Location media count
locationMediaCount.description: Total media tagged at this place - far larger than the page of media this actor can retrieve.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Public phone number for the place, when it publishes one.

priceRange.title: Price range
priceRange.description: Instagram's price tier for the place.

street.title: Street
street.description: Street address, when the place publishes one.

openingHoursStatus.title: Opening hours status
openingHoursStatus.description: Opening-hours status string for the place.
